newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen falling slightly.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen falling slightly.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to decline slightly on Friday on concerns that first quarter earnings of some companies, other than banks and finance firms, due later in May could fall below expectations, brokers said.
Banks and finance firms released their results late last month. There was also worry that wage increases sought by Thai workers may fuel inflation, they added.
The composite SET index rose 2.70 points to 661.29 on 3.5 billion baht turnover on Wednesday. The SET-50 index gained 0.24 point to 48.92.
The market was closed on Thursday for Labour Day holiday.
